title: Karbobala ke manzar Allahu Akbar
body:
karbobala ke manzar allahu akber
lashe pade hai'n besar allahu akber
bachhe tadap rahe hai'n qaime ke dar pe pyaase
kehti hai ye bhatiji paani pilaado laake
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi hai ye qayamat ab bawafa pe haaye
jaate hai mashk lekar allahu akber
betou'n ko apni maa ne samjha ke ran ko bheja
rakhna khayal itna dourane jang beta
<<DIVIDER>>
dariya ki wo hawa bhi mehsoos tum na karna
pyaasa hai bhai asgher allahu akber
akber gaye jo ran ko bechain ho gayi maa aur jism se pidar ki jaise nikal gayi jaa'n
zainab ko yaad aaye sughra ke haaye armaan
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra saja na sar parallahu akber
bas sonchte yahi hain zakhmi pisar ko lekar
banu ke rubaru ab jayenge kaise sarwar
har ek qadam pa sheh ke chalte hain dil pe khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
goudi me laashe asgher allahu akber
mazloom e karbala ke hoto'n pe ye sada hai
aao madad ko ghaazi zakhmo'n ka silsila hai
zulm o sitam me dekho har pal guzar raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye mera muqaddar allahu akber
abbas teri khwahar jab be rida huwi hai
roti huwi nigahe'n dariya ki jaa huwi hai
pathhar bhi toot jaaye aisi jafa huwi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har pal hai dil pe khanjar allahu akber
baandhi gayi phupi ke bazu me reesmaa'n ab
nazro'n me chaarsu hai ek dard ka samaa'n ab
kaise sambhaale dil ko beemar e natawa'n ab
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab huwi khule sar allahu akber
maida'n me binte haider bhai ko dekhti hai
ibne ali ki nazre'n khwahar ko dhoondti hai
aankho'n me shaah e dee'n ke dekho fida nami hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise likhu'n ye manzar allahu akber
